soft1e-3 capture to compare against clean (002): the summary-token difference should be large already within the first blocks if a specific early feature fires on the 0.6 GeV photon.
soft1e-3 MLP hidden activations of blocks 0,1: expect a few hidden units on the added photon token to be outliers vs clean neutral tokens.

Constructed jets with one added photon/neutral hadron at log-uniform 1e-5..1e-2 of jet pT; block0 MLP inputs give positives for a linear soft-neutral detector; logits show the response vs pT and pid.

Block0 MLP unit 308 gates neutrals with log_pt<0.2 and saturates their residual to a fixed sign pattern whose key is ~7 logits below the row LSE (median); this should cut soft1e-3/1e-4 responses strongly, but ~1.9 clean neutrals per jet are also gated, so clean side effects are moderate.

Same gate+saturation circuit with a very sharp gate (kappa=1000) at log_pt<-0.1 so almost no token falls in the GELU negative lobe (which made 011 tokens into attention magnets); expect clean damage to drop to a few 1e-3 and soft1e-3/1e-4 responses to fall, gen_drift still large because noised neutrals are gated.

Diffusion-noised clean jets (t=0.1..0.85) give exactly the block0 MLP inputs the generator sees (block0 is time independent). Expect my soft-neutral gate to fire on a large fraction of noised neutrals at t>=0.5, which explains gen_drift, and these tokens can be used as negatives for a noise veto.

Gate (log_pt<-0.1 neutrals, kappa 1000) saturates the token; per-block rank-1 query/key edits (constant-query direction x saturated-key direction, min-variance head direction) push its logit 12-30 below every row LSE, so gated tokens become inert. Expect clean damage small (KL<0.05) and soft1e-3/soft1e-4 ratios well below 012; gen_drift still sizable (noised neutrals gated).

Same as 014 but the gate subtracts 2x a ridge 'diffusion-noise' readout (fit on noised jets captured at block0), so noised neutrals in the generator check are rarely gated; expect gen_drift much lower than 014 at slightly worse soft1e-3 ratio.

Original-model logits on tgt_-0.1 (512 jets each of soft1e-3, soft1e-4, P, clean; tgt_* have neutrals below the given absolute log_pt removed) to build a proxy of the target error e_v under two threshold hypotheses.

Diagnose e3: jets with exploding logits should contain a token whose gate unit 308 activation is negative (GELU lobe, pushing -s which the QK edit turns into a +30 logit bonus) or partial.

Chained 5-unit gate (no GELU negative lobe) saturates neutrals with log_pt<-0.1 into sign pattern s_late (key margins <= -1..-4.5 in blocks 4-11 and classifier); rank-1 QK edits only in blocks 1-3 (offline KL ~1e-4). Expect clean damage small now and soft1e-3 ratio ~0.15.
As e5 plus light rank-1 QK edits (penalty 6 logits) in blocks 4-8 and both classifier blocks: stronger suppression of gated tokens at small extra distortion (offline KL<=3e-3 per block).

Original-model block0 MLP inputs on split2 (1024 jets): the two collinear halves have a zero-distance kNN neighbour, so my linear log_pt readout should be off for them and the gate fires on hard split photons, explaining e5's split2 ratio 3.7. These tokens become extra training data for the readouts.
Block0 MLP inputs on soft3e-3: added photons have log_pt 0.4-1.1 so should not be gated; if some are (readout error for isolated photons), it explains soft3e-3 ratio 1.3.

Chained gate + saturation to s_late with NO QK edits: removes the QK-edit distortion (0.044 S on jets without soft neutrals, and the split2 ratio 3.7 that I attribute to OOD twin tokens hitting the key edit), at the cost of weaker suppression in blocks 1-3 (margins up to +13 for rare queries).
Original residuals on split2 (512 jets) as extra (legit, slightly OOD) tokens for a more robust least-squares fit of the QK-edit directions in blocks 1-3 and classifier keys.
Original residuals on soft3e-3 (512 jets) as extra (legit, slightly OOD) tokens for a more robust least-squares fit of the QK-edit directions in blocks 1-3 and classifier keys.

e7 with threshold lowered to log_pt<-0.2 and readouts refit on 88k tokens (incl. split2/soft3e-3/custom): 9x fewer neutrals cross the threshold under J, so rho_J returns towards 1 and P_ref towards 1, clean KL drops; soft1e-3 ratio slightly worse (93.5% of probe photons gated).

orig logits on unseen-probe-like jets (soft neutral hadron at 1e-3 and 1e-4, two soft photons, photon at 0.4<dR<0.8). The gate reads neutrality from the pid embedding (6 and 7 alike), so e8 should cut all four responses like soft1e-3/1e-4.

Check gate firing (units 308,379,247,255,280) on added soft neutral hadrons / photon pairs / wide photons in e8; expect >90% of added tokens with log_pt<-0.2 fully gated; if NH at 1e-4 are not, the log_pt readout extrapolates badly for pid 7.

e8 gate plus rank-2 QK edits in body blocks 1-3 refit with split2/soft3e-3 tokens (twin tokens now |n|<0.002): suppresses the rare queries that still attend to gated tokens in blocks 1-3 without the split2 damage seen in e5.

e10 on unseen-probe-like jets; expect lower ratios than e8 (0.23/0.51/0.31/0.17) if attention leakage in blocks 1-3 drives the residual.

e8 + weaker robust QK edits only in blocks 1-2 (penalties 14,12 logits instead of 26,25,17): removes the +13/+12 positive soft-key margins of rare particle queries while roughly halving the clean distortion seen with e10.

e8 with threshold log_pt<-0.15: gates ~96% of soft1e-3 photons and more P neutrals (better P target match), at the cost of ~4x more J threshold crossings than e8 (rho_J ~1.07) and slightly more clean change.

e14 + robust QK edit in classifier block 0 (penalty 8): the classifier is the last reader so this edit is not amplified; expect slightly lower soft ratios than e14 with nearly the same clean side effects.
